## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] For a contract change, `npm run test:deep`, `npm run pilot:rehearse` and `npm run test:fork` pass, as CONTRIBUTING.md describes.
- [ ] The specification, the accepted risks and the guide reflect the change.
- [ ] A fixed issue has a test in `test/GRETVault.protections.t.sol`; a newly accepted risk has an entry in `docs/ACCEPTED_RISKS.md` and a test named after its ID.
